  "text": "Nvidia raised this outlook to 75% from 70% a week ago with demand ahead of supply, so a cut within one quarter needs something to change. Three things can: the 90-day licence deadline for overseas data centres serving Chinese customers falls about ten days before the report, on sales Luria puts at 5% to 20% of the total; customer financing ('access to capital for a large number of neoclouds is going to disappear' if Nvidia stops guaranteeing, per Apollo's Rowan), with the $500 billion plan yet to fund a deal; and an interim or newly arrived CEO resetting the bar. One in five."
